details.description: gpt-daybreak-red-latest (Daybreak Red) is an alias in OpenAI's Daybreak program for OpenAI's most advanced purpose-trained cybersecurity models, for approved defenders doing authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and security testing. It currently resolves to the GPT-5.6 Cyber snapshot (gpt-5.6-cyber), takes text and image input, and supports reasoning tokens. Its knowledge cutoff is February 16, 2026. Use requires separate approval and provisioning through the Daybreak program.
advantages: OpenAI describes it as an alias for its most advanced purpose-trained cybersecurity models, for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and security testing (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-red-latest model page).

Currently resolves to the GPT-5.6 Cyber snapshot, which supports reasoning tokens, streaming, function calling, structured outputs, code interpreter, hosted shell, apply patch, computer use, MCP and tool search (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-red-latest model page).
Snapshots let approved users pin a specific version instead of tracking the alias, per OpenAI's documentation (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-red-latest model page).
disadvantages: Requires separate OpenAI approval and provisioning through the Daybreak program before it can be used (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-red-latest model page).
Does not support audio or video input, or fine-tuning (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-red-latest model page).
use_cases: Exploit validation for approved security teams
Security testing under OpenAI's Daybreak program

notes: Catalog facts (400,000 input / 128,000 output tokens, image_input+text_input+text_output, /v1/chat/completions) match the OpenAI model page and its own listed snapshot, gpt-5.6-cyber. As a '-latest' alias, the underlying snapshot it points to can change over time. No benchmark table was published on the pages opened, so evaluations is left empty.
